subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2: Climate Change – Reading and Understanding
outcomes: Read a temperature chart and explain its trend.
Understand a text about the causes and effects of climate change.
Predict the future of endangered animals using will and won't.

tf.s: The chart shows that average global temperatures have risen since 1881.
tf.why: Yes! The trend goes up from 1881 to 2010.

tf.s: The horizontal axis of the chart shows the temperatures.
tf.why: The horizontal axis shows the years, 1881–2010.

tf.s: Burning fossil fuels produces greenhouse gases.
tf.why: Correct, and these gases warm the Earth.

tf.s: The Earth is getting hotter because there are more ice caps.
tf.why: It is because there are more greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.

tf.s: Countries at sea level are at risk from floods.
tf.why: Right, rising sea levels threaten them.

tf.s: 'Release' means to let something out, for example gases.
If the ice melts, polar bears will hunt seals more easily.
tf.why: Polar bears won't be able to hunt seals without the ice.

tf.s: Turtles may have to lay their eggs somewhere else if their nesting beaches disappear.
tf.why: Yes, that is a prediction from the text.

tf.s: 'Will able to' is the correct form for future ability.
tf.why: We say 'will be able to' or 'won't be able to'.

tf.s: Only governments can do something about climate change; individuals can do nothing.
tf.why: Individuals can change their habits too.

boxes.q: What kind of chart is in Activity 1?
boxes.why: It uses vertical columns for each period.

boxes.q: What does the horizontal axis show?
boxes.why: It shows the years from 1881 to 2010.

boxes.q: There are more ___ in the atmosphere, so the Earth is getting hotter.
Countries at sea level are at risk from ...
boxes.why: Rising sea levels can flood low land.

o: How can we stop climate change?

boxes.q: If the ice melts, polar bears ___ be able to hunt seals.

o: the natural home of an animal
boxes.why: Melting ice destroys the polar bear's habitat.

o: coal, oil and gas we burn for energy

boxes.q: Which word means 'having a duty to deal with something'?
boxes.why: Stopping climate change is everyone's responsibility.

mcq.q: What trend does the chart show?
mcq.why: The columns get higher from 1881 to 2010.

mcq.q: What are greenhouse gases produced by, according to the text?
mcq.why: The text names fossil fuels and bacteria.

mcq.q: Which subheading matches the paragraph about stopping climate change?
o: How can we stop climate change?

mcq.q: Which three animals are in the texts?
mcq.why: Climate change threatens these three animals.

o: Polar bears won't be able to hunt seals.
Polar bears won't able to hunt seals.
Polar bears will not be able hunt seals.
Polar bears not will be able to hunt seals.

mcq.q: Nesting beaches will disappear. What will turtles have to do?
mcq.why: They will need a new place for their eggs.

mcq.q: Choose the correct sentence with 'will have to'.
o: We will have to use less energy.
We will has to use less energy.
We will have use less energy.
We have will to use less energy.

mcq.q: What might cause the rising trend in the chart?
o: more greenhouse gases from burning fossil fuels
mcq.why: These gases trap heat in the atmosphere.

mcq.q: Why are countries at sea level at risk?
o: Rising sea levels can flood them.
mcq.why: Melting ice raises the sea level.

mcq.q: Why does predicting before reading help you?
o: It activates what you know and prepares you for the ideas.
It means you don't need to read.
mcq.why: Predicting gets your mind ready for the text.
